dct_description_sm: The project evaluated the effect of Anuew (Prohexadione-Calcium) as compared with the industry standard, Primo Maxx (Trinexapac-ethyl) on turfgrass growth and quality parameters on a mature bentgrass-poa annua fairway height stand of turf. Performance was assessed by how the treatments impacted turfgrass growth (clipping biomass), any stress where observed, and associated turfgrass quality measures.
